object_presence.name: object_presence
notes: Recall by bin = share of annotated objects whose class the VLM mentioned (a class-level proxy: the VLM does not localise objects).

text_faithfulness.name: text_faithfulness
notes: Claims are extracted from the description with a rule-based lexicon (see parsing/text_claims.py). Agreement is computed for structured answers (JSON or questionnaire).

consistency.name: consistency
notes: Scene-level GT attributes never change within a scene, so any attribute flip by the model is an inconsistency.
